title: Present Pop - a holiday themed bubble shooter
author: blackwidowink
selftext:
Hey guys,

Just wanted to share a casual bubble shooter game that I vibed for the holidays. It features:

- dual bubble cannons
- five unique bosses
- five upgrades for your cannons
- infinite levels
- dancing elves!

Feel free to check it out and let me know what you think. Link in the comments.

replies.author: xJohn_Snow
replies.body:
Looks fun! The dual bubble cannons and boss fights actually make it stand out from the usual holiday-themed bubble shooters, but when I tried to check it out, it said the site doesn’t exist. Too bad. Also, I was going to suggest putting this on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) since it feels like the kind of quirky, cozy project that would fit there and the devs there gives detailed feedback and suggestions.

https://preview.redd.it/dmfpr4javb5g1.png?width=870&format=png&auto=webp&s=eceb0d55c02e0e487aabb10b6d0f8aac2b570e88

comments.author: redditisstupid4real
comments.body: Actually creative and fun! Great stuff! Were the assets AI genned too? Code help? Curious how you leveraged AI

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body: Thanks! Everything is AI generated. The visual assets, sound affects, animations and code is all generated at Astrocade.com using their game creation engine. I generated the music at Producer.ai.

replies.author: qqepyepuep
replies.body: Can you generate sound effects to download?

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body: I don’t think you can download them, no. Elevenlabs.io is good for that.

comments.author: plaknasaurus
comments.body:
Thats really cool! Very polished. 
How long did it take you?
I didn't know Astrocade had animations. I had tried it but it was just swapping images. How did you create animations?

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body: Thanks! Took me a couple weeks in my spare time. Astrocade has animations that you can unlock if they like your creations. It isn’t available right from the start. At first I was using Autosprite for my animations.

comments.author: LopsidedLobster2100
comments.body: What were some of your prompts?

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body:
There were a lot of them. My first prompt was: 
“Shoot festive presents from two cannons to match three or more of the same color, clearing the hexagonal grid before the presents descend to the bottom.
• Christmas theme with gift boxes, elves, and a workshop background
• Trajectory line and satisfying pop particle effects”
